continuous_width_contact_argument: At q90 every part lies behind front plane er dot X = R-6. For any centered cylinder diameter or aligned square width W in [50,120], choose R=W/2+6. Local [65,0,9.5] on each finite skin maps to W/2*er+[0,0,85], within object Z55..115. Before contact R>W/2+6 all petal solids are outside the object support half-space; at contact no positive overlap. This proves a nominal geometric touch, not deformation, friction, force closure or holding.
